description: This file implements a gRPC-based tunnel client for the Kubernetes apiserver-network-proxy, including connection management, dialing, and stream handling.

classes.name: grpcTunnel
classes.description: Implements the Tunnel interface, managing gRPC stream connections, dialing, and connection lifecycle.

classes.name: clientConn
classes.description: Interface for client connection, with a Close() method.

classes.name: dialFailure
classes.description: Represents a dial failure with an error message and reason.

methods.name: CreateSingleUseGrpcTunnel
methods.description: Creates a single-use gRPC tunnel with default context.

methods.name: CreateSingleUseGrpcTunnelWithContext
methods.description: Creates a gRPC tunnel with specified create and tunnel contexts.

methods.name: serve
methods.description: Main loop for receiving and processing packets from the gRPC stream.

methods.name: DialContext
methods.description: Establishes a new connection through the tunnel.

methods.name: dialContext
methods.description: Internal method to handle dialing logic, including timeout and context handling.

methods.name: Done
methods.description: Returns a channel that is closed when the tunnel is no longer active.

methods.name: sendCloseRequest
methods.description: Sends a request to close a specific connection.

methods.name: sendDialClose
methods.description: Sends a request to close a dial attempt.

methods.name: closeTunnel
methods.description: Closes the tunnel and updates connection metrics.

methods.name: isClosing
methods.description: Checks if the tunnel is in the process of closing.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends a packet over the gRPC stream.

methods.name: Recv
methods.description: Receives a packet from the gRPC stream.

methods.name: GetDialFailureReason
methods.description: Determines if an error is a dial failure and returns the reason.
